register.name: RPPO (Registar proizvođača s proširenom odgovornošću)
register.operator: FZOEU (Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund)
register.notes: Valsts pārvaldīts maksu modelis: ražotāji maksā tieši Fondam (FZOEU), privātu PRO nav. Maksas nosaka Uredba o gospodarenju otpadnom ambalažom un publicē kā oficiālu maksu sarakstu (popis naknada).

pro.ecoModulation: Fees are the Fund's collection costs (troškovi sakupljanja) per material for packaging outside the deposit-return system; aluminium (0.296 €/kg) is far dearer than steel (0.112). Beverage PET/glass/Al/Fe run through a separate deposit-return system (povratna naknada 0.10 €/unit).

extraTaxes.name: Poticajna naknada
extraTaxes.summary: Veicināšanas maksa par tirgū laisto iepakojumu, ko maksā FZOEU līdzās parastajai iepakojuma apsaimniekošanas maksai (naknada gospodarenja).

notes: Rates from the official FZOEU 'POPIS NAKNADA u sustavu gospodarenja otpadnom ambalažom' fee list effective 20.05.2026 (fetched and parsed 2026-08-16), packaging outside the deposit-return system, collection-cost fee €/t → €/kg: paper/cardboard 119 → 0.119, polymer/plastic 302 → 0.302, glass (non-deposit) 25 → 0.025, steel (Fe) 112 → 0.112 (shown as 'metal'; aluminium 296 → 0.296), wood 36 → 0.036, multilayer/composite (mostly paper-card) 160 → 0.160, textile 100 → 0.100. NOTE: amounts are gross incl. Croatian VAT (per the fee list's own note), so net rates are lower. Transport costs (€/t·km) are billed separately.

drs.note: Dzērienu PET, stikls un metāla bundžas.
